name: Eco-kichi
source:
A mascot character that [url=/c73540]Achi[/url] wears on his shirt. The punks of Shibuya are able to recognize Achi simply by his Eco-kichi/Mean Clean shirt.

[spoiler]Eco-kichi/Mean Clean is the protagonist of the 3rd unlockable scenario in the post-game. He and his fellow anthropomorphic friends attempt to stop the pollution threatening Shibuya.[/spoiler]
